hot_path_findings.finding: Independent source reads were logically parallelizable but could still be followed by duplicate full-source rereads by Final Lead, writers or reviewers.
hot_path_findings.candidate_action: Build same-wave ready sets, extract once into a reusable evidence_pack, pass evidence-pack slices, and allow only reasoned targeted rereads when source bytes change, coverage is incomplete, facts conflict, or high-risk facts require direct source verification.

hot_path_findings.finding: A global single-writer interpretation could serialize independent DOCX/XLSX production.
hot_path_findings.candidate_action: Use one writer per artifact/path with isolated scratch; independent final artifacts may generate in parallel only after the shared fact baseline is stable and outputs do not overlap.

hot_path_findings.finding: One reviewer walking multiple independent final artifacts serially can recreate a review queue after parallel production.
hot_path_findings.candidate_action: Permit artifact-scoped read-only review instances on immutable candidates when net benefit is positive, then perform one cross-artifact consistency join without weakening minimum independent review strength.

hot_path_findings.finding: Thread parallelism was negative; process parallelism materially reduced wall clock for heavy independent OOXML inspections.
hot_path_findings.candidate_action: Keep process-parallel batch inspection only for sufficiently heavy independent files with positive expected benefit; simple/light work stays on the original single-file path. If process infrastructure is unavailable, run the same checks serially and record serial_fallback rather than skipping inspection or claiming speedup.

hot_path_findings.finding: Routine non-light entry previously fixed-loaded Core + Router + classification + routing map before task-specific modules.
hot_path_findings.candidate_action: Keep Router as the routine hot core and load classification detail, routing map, Core, Orchestrator and Review only when they can change the current decision.

hot_path_findings.finding: Hosted regression modules complete their delivery-hook and delivery-rule test groups in only tens of milliseconds on test fixtures; no evidence currently supports making the fail-closed Delivery Gate more complex for speed.
hot_path_findings.candidate_action: Leave Delivery Gate semantics unchanged; optimize only if target-work profiling later shows a material share of end-to-end wall clock.

implemented_changes: T0 builds a minimal dependency map and same-wave ready-set for independent positive-benefit work.
Performance scenarios themselves carry the representative parallel profile instead of tests secretly injecting fan-out parameters.
Source extraction is reused through evidence_pack; unreasoned duplicate full-source rereads are disallowed.
Routine non-light control-plane fixed loading is reduced from four modules to Router-only, with other modules loaded on demand.
Independent final artifacts use one writer per artifact/path and may be produced in parallel after a stable shared fact baseline.
Independent immutable artifacts may use artifact-scoped parallel review followed by one cross-artifact consistency join.
Independent nontrivial DOCX/XLSX mechanical inspections may use a process-parallel batch path only when expected net benefit is positive.
Office process-parallel inspection falls back to the same serial checks when process infrastructure is unavailable, and the fallback cannot be counted as parallel speedup.
Simple tasks remain single-executor and required independent review strength remains unchanged.

performance_iterations.interpretation: Thread parallelism did not shorten this CPU-heavy inspection path and was replaced rather than retained for appearance.

Process-pool regression tests passed, but an inline-stdin benchmark could not be reloaded by macOS spawn. The benchmark harness was corrected to run from a real module file; no Cabinet quality gate was weakened.

performance_iterations.workload: 6 separate runs of 8 independent synthetic DOCX inspections with 24000 paragraphs each
performance_iterations.interpretation: Six hosted-macOS runs show the same direction and materially lower wall clock for sufficiently heavy independent Office inspection. This is component-level synthetic evidence only and does not prove end-to-end real-office speed.
The candidate removes about 60% of fixed rule-material bytes from the routine non-light entry path. This is a structural context/load proxy, not a wall-clock speed claim.

hosted_macos_module_diagnostic.known_runtime_issue: The lifecycle case can fail inside the full test_evolution_loop module on GitHub-hosted macOS because the maintenance sandbox cannot initialize in that hosted process state; the identical lifecycle case passes in a fresh process.

delivery_hot_path_observation.delivery_hook_group: 20 tests in approximately 0.03-0.04 seconds on hosted test fixtures
delivery_hot_path_observation.delivery_rules_group: 23 tests in approximately 0.06-0.08 seconds on hosted test fixtures
delivery_hot_path_observation.interpretation: These are fixture-level timings only, but they provide no present evidence that Delivery Gate mechanics are the dominant end-to-end cost.

not_yet_proven: Target Mac repo-native full-suite PASS for the final immutable v1.5.4 candidate.
Real-office end-to-end Before/After wall-clock improvement on comparable QV-03 and QV-06 shaped work.
Two independent candidate reviews on the final immutable candidate.
A stable real-work end-to-end ratio at or below the directional 0.70 target.
